operation: Read-only rendering of packaged CFD values and explicitly conceptual workflow artwork. No training, CFD solve, or inference.

source.coordinate_check: X varies along columns; Y along rows; uniform 0..1, 801 nodes; increasing Y plotted upward
source.identity: Packaged standard Config 3 CFD field from which bootstrap grids were subsampled; not NNLCI output

scientific_panels.normalization: Linear, complete source min/max per variable; same scales in detail and full domain
scientific_panels.rendering: 80 filled contour intervals and 15 isolines; standard contour interpolation only; no smoothing, field fabrication, or numerical modification

concept_assets.field_imagery: Same source density detail; LF1/LF2 artwork subsamples rows and columns with strides 8/4 (matching bootstrap sampling); goal uses stride 1. Nearest-neighbor display. This is not an LF/prediction/HF scientific comparison.
concept_assets.colorbar: None on concept artwork; numerical colorbars only on scientific panels
concept_assets.mechanism: Two aligned 3x3 neighborhoods depicted schematically, concatenated LF token, local map, refined value. HF supervisor connects only to training loss; inference uses LF and fixed transforms.

excluded_prediction_array.reason: Sampled training rows have no saved spatial coordinates; do not reshape or interpolate into a purported prediction field.

evidence_boundary: Two-epoch Config 3 bootstrap uses subsamples of one CFD solution; default evaluation reads training arrays. Neither these figures nor the animation establish held-out reconstruction, conservation, stability, generalization, or speedup.

animation.meaning: Conceptual presentation sequence; highlight inputs, map, and goal. No physical time or iterative solver steps.
